name: claude-code-ltm
description: Retrieve past Claude Code conversations from this machine's own transcript corpus, with pointers back to the original turns.
long_description: claude-LTM indexes the Claude Code transcripts already on this machine (~/.claude/projects) and lets a model look things up in them. Retrieval is navigation, not answering: every hit carries (project, sessions, uuid, timestamp) so you can go read the original turn. Fully on-device — semantic vectors via NLContextualEmbedding, lexical search via SQLite FTS5, no API key and no cloud dependency. The transcript corpus is treated as strictly read-only. Run `ltm build` once before first use to create the index; the index is a pure derivative and is always safe to delete and rebuild.

tools.name: ltm_query
tools.description: Query past Claude Code conversations on this machine. Returns hits carrying (project, sessions, uuid, timestamp) pointers so you can read the original. Defaults to the project matching the current working directory.
